capabilities: Annotate selected text in Reading view
Annotate whole blocks such as paragraphs, tables and images
Align cards in the gutter with leader lines back to the text
List, jump to, edit and delete annotations in an overview panel
Export an annotation review list as Markdown
disambiguation: Not a flashcard or spaced-repetition tool; the cards are margin annotations shown beside text in Reading view.
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); mobile is unsupported and untested. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer; below 1.8.7 the 'Follow Obsidian' language option falls back to the system language. The plugin writes only 批注.json and the optional exported review list, and makes no network requests.
motivation: The author wanted .md files to stay byte-for-byte identical so they keep syncing, diffing and version-controlling cleanly, and annotations survive plugin removal.
problem: Annotating a note normally means writing into the Markdown itself, which dirties syncing, diffs and version control.
summary: Reading-view annotation tool that places note cards in the page gutter beside the annotated line, keeping all annotations in one JSON file.
